page.layout: One column of running text, centred heading "RESPONSIO." above it. Running head at top, printed page number "255" at top right. Signature "R" and catchword "pessio-" at the foot. No marginal notes. A handwritten "344" sits at top right and is not transcribed.

main_text.head: RESPONSIO.
main_text.p: Satis est, quicquid etiam rationabi-liter dici queat, quod pro nobis PAS-SUS est DOMINUS GLORIÆ, & DEUS BENEDICTUS in secula[?]. A-ctor. 20.28. Deus sanguine suo redemit Eccle-siam. Hic Deus infinitus uno actu omnē illam infinitate præstare potest. 1. Cor. 2. 8. Dominum gloriæ crucifixerunt, non purum & merum hominem. Rom. 9. v. 5. Fuit quidem Christus, qui pro nobis est passus, ex Iudaeis[?], secundum carnem, sed est etiam supra omnes Deus laudandus in secula.

Hic per SPIRITUM æternum se obtulit Deo. Heb. 9. 14. Hinc vis purga-tis sanguinis Christi pendet, primum ab excellentia divinæ naturæ Christi. Obtulit enim se per SPIRITUM æter-num; Postea a sanctitate naturæ suæ humanæ: obtulit enim se inculpatum Deo. Ergo nos redemtos esse pretioso sanguine Christi tanquam agni inculpati & incontaminati, dicit Petrus.
Quare hinc fieri dicimus, ut propter dignitatem personæ patientis & morientis, & simul infinitum pretium per-

page.notes: Handwritten "344" at top right is not printed text and is left out. The page number "255" in the head is set in a damaged form and is uncertain. Doubtful readings: "secula" (printed with a cedilla on the c), "Iudaeis", "æternum" and "æter-num" are read from a worn scan. The catchword "pessio-" continues the broken word "per-" at the end of the last line. Hyphens are printed and kept as they stand.
